reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and I'm not letting an AI I don't know run automations 24/7 on our CRM and talk to customers on my behalf. 'GDPR-compliant' in one line isn't proof, and I'd need to see it work on our own data before I spend a cent.
objection: An AI sending something wrong to a client or mishandling customer data from our CRM, with me only finding out afterwards. And I can't tell what 100 'credits' actually gets me, so the real monthly cost is unclear.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on our own data with EU hosting and a signed DPA in writing, every customer-facing message needing my approval before it goes out, and a peer business in Belgium or France showing real results.
